evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creation of games is present and complementary capabilities (invite, browse, delete, view transcript) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL
evaluations.rationale: Invite-by-URL is supported and there are stories for joining and limiting estimators; no complementary capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item
evaluations.rationale: Round/item creation is supported and there are stories for selecting, editing, deleting, and listing items.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Listing items in session is covered and complementary item CRUD operations exist.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection and re-estimation are supported alongside item management; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Item addition exists and is complemented by edit/delete/list stories.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Edit is present and matched with create, delete, and list operations.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Delete behavior is paired with create/edit/list; no complementary create capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Moderator override to show estimates is described and complementary estimate display mechanics exist.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an agreed estimate is supported alongside entering agreed estimate and automatic fill behaviors.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic acceptance of unanimous estimates is supported and relies on existing estimate display mechanics; no missing complementary capability found.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Moderator entering final agreed estimate complements other estimate acceptance and recording stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation is supported and prior-estimate browsing and selection stories exist to enable this.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Import and copy/paste options are both present, covering bulk story entry; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Bulk entry via copy/paste complements import and individual item creation; no missing capability detected.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior games is supported and there are stories for creating, viewing transcripts and exporting games; complementary persistence is implied.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Transcript viewing exists and is complemented by export and browse stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Exporting transcripts is supported and the view transcript story provides the necessary source; no export-related capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript viewing and browsing; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion is present and creation/browse/export stories exist; no delete-without-create gap.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present and is complemented by login, change and delete account stories.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is present and paired with account creation and change/delete stories; required complementary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account detail modification complements account creation and login; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account, so that account information and games are no longer stored
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion exists and game deletion is also present; the necessary complementary deletion capabilities are available.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a presentation concern and no necessary complementary capability is absent in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder implies complementary capabilities (email delivery, secure reset-token flow and password reset UI) that are not represented in the backlog; those necessary capabilities are missing.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, ...} or {0, 1, 2, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting card sets is self-contained and no complementary capability is missing to make it usable.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invite limit is specified and invite/join stories exist; no complementary capability preventing this is missing.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Estimator join by URL is present and complemented by moderator invite behavior; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Estimator view of current item is supported by moderator selection and round-start stories; complementary capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Participant listing of session items is covered by item list and item management stories.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Participant visibility of who has estimated is supported by existing estimate-display stories; no missing complementary capability found.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simultaneous reveal behavior is defined and complemented by participant estimate mechanics; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change before reveal is supported and consistent with other estimate control stories; no necessary complement missing.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Prior-estimate visibility is supported by transcript and historic-round browsing stories, so required storage and access are present in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Current-round attribution is covered by estimate-display and participant-identification stories; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Shared timer functionality is self-contained in the backlog and no complementary capability is missing to implement it.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset behavior complements the timer start story; required complementary capability (detecting all players' estimates) is present.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Browsing prior rounds is supported and complemented by transcript and storage-related stories; no missing complementary capability identified.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card ordering is a presentation requirement and does not expose missing complementary capabilities in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate-change rules are present and supported by reveal/draw-completion stories; no required capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail implies capabilities to upload/manage avatars and privacy/consent controls (and/or link photos to accounts); the backlog contains no story for uploading or managing participant photos or handling related privacy controls.

evaluations.evidence: site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Developer compliance story is standalone and does not reveal a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary/definitions is a self-contained developer/documentation story and does not expose missing functional complements.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Indexing is an implementation task that complements performance-related stories; backlog includes related performance concerns.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility goals are listed; no missing complementary user stories are needed to specify functionality for those browsers.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility requirement is stated and does not reveal a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement is present and complemented by developer stories about indexes and optimization; no missing complementary story found.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is stated; it is an implementation detail and does not reveal a missing complementary user story.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is specified as a requirement; no complementary capability is missing to realize it.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error page requirement is present and does not expose a missing complementary capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Non-identifiable storage requires complementary capabilities (anonymization/pseudonymization, data export masking, opt-out/consent flows) which are not represented; without these, the story cannot be implemented correctly alongside other stories that expose identifiable data (names, thumbnails).

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Providing metrics implies collecting, storing and presenting usage data (instrumentation and an admin/metrics view) which are not reflected in the backlog; these necessary complementary capabilities are missing.
